title: Anatomy of an Echo
description: Read the novel to question what a likeness may ask of the people who remain.

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: Anatomy of an Echo asks who may continue a life that others recognize. Read it for the tension between recognizing someone and accepting their claim on a relationship.
readerInvitation.readerPromise: Read the novel to question what a likeness may ask of the people who remain.
readerInvitation.audienceFit: The story suits readers drawn to intimate science fiction and difficult institutions.
readerInvitation.closingInvitation: Begin with The Bowl That Listened, then follow the unexpected recording into the clinic's claims.
readerOutcomes: Attend to who consents, who can refuse, and who controls the conditions of speaking.
Recognition makes the message disturbing, but cannot establish who or what produced it.
